objectives.text: Find the card with two green circles that a short green house that is 3 tiles from a short blue house is next to.
Find the card with two green plusses that a tall grey house that is next to a short blue house is beside.
Find the card with one black square that a tall red house that is 2 tiles from a rock is next to.
Find the card with two blue circles that a short green house that is 3 tiles from a short blue house is next to.
Find the card with two blue squares that a tree that is beside another tree is next to.
Find the card with two orange plusses that a short red house that is 2 tiles from a short blue house is beside.
Find the card with two red diamonds that a short yellow house that is 2 tiles from another short yellow house is next to.
Find the card with one black circle that a short grey house that is next to a tree is beside.
Find the card with two black plusses that a tree that is beside a tall blue house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one orange star that a tall blue house that is next to a short red house is next to.
Find the card with two blue stars that a short blue house that is beside a short yellow house is next to.
Find the card with two green squares that a tall blue house that is next to a short red house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two red stars that a short yellow house that is next to a short grey house is next to.
Find the card with one red star that a tall red house that is 3 tiles from a short blue house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one green star that a tree that is 2 tiles from a short red house is next to.
